title: TypeScript provider request subject
description: The subject member of the admitted canonical request, mirrored from the provider's own validation. This document is the admitted mirror; the validator is the authority.

sourceContract.drift: protocol.mjs validateRequest is the authority and this document is its admitted mirror: a change to those lines requires a change here. Allowed keys are exactly the SUBJECT_KEYS entry of the kind (:57-61). Every kind carries a nonempty path whose suffix is in SOURCE_SUFFIXES (:49, sourceSuffixMatches :70-73); position and diagnostic carry line and column as u32 (:117-120); symbol carries a nonempty name and a container string that defaults to the empty string (:121-124); diagnostic carries a nonempty code (:125-127).
sourceContract.identityNote: no $id is set: the admitted identity is a hole for package admission to fill, named by the inventory it admits.

crossFieldRules.detail: the keys of one subject are exactly the SUBJECT_KEYS entry of its kind; a member outside that set refuses with context-subject-unknown-field, and an unknown kind refuses with context-subject-unknown
requireU32 admits a safe integer from 0 to 0xffffffff, and nothing else
requireNonEmptyString admits a string of length at least one, and nothing else
